title: Turn a title into a URL slug
description:
src/text.py has a function slugify(text) that should turn any title into a clean URL slug.

The rules for a slug are:
- it is lowercase
- accented letters become their plain ASCII equivalent, so an e-acute becomes e
- every run of characters that is not a letter or a digit collapses into a single hyphen, so spaces, punctuation and underscores all become one hyphen
- there is never a hyphen at the start or at the end
- a title with no letters or digits at all produces the empty string

Some of the tests in tests/test_visible.py are failing. Find out why and fix src/text.py.
